relationships.rationale: The selected contract makes branch comparison and noncanonical world evidence executable.
Twelve hostile cases exercise the comparison boundary.
The deterministic validator checks branch, criterion, evidence, actor, and authority invariants.
Built branch consequences can introduce difference without becoming branch truth.
TurtleAsk provides the contrasting case of genuine human otherness; branch-derived perturbation must remain a different provenance class.
After comparison without ranking, the next risk is moving insight across branches without silent merge.

ctc_tags.rationale: Human purpose governs which branch consequences and criteria matter.
Divergent consequences may create new questions instead of one answer.

ctc_tags.domain: Technology as Tool to Think With
ctc_tags.rationale: Branches and evidence are manipulable computational material rather than a leaderboard.
Branch revisions may later contribute evidence, but branch performance is not proof of learning.
Participants may compare, reject comparison, or revise criteria.
Ranking criteria may encode hidden efficiency, value, aesthetic, and power assumptions.
Collaboration can preserve parallel worlds without compulsory convergence.

ontology_tags.rationale: Multiple built possibilities remain materially available after comparison.
Different interpretations are inhabited before their consequences are compared.
Human purpose, Turtle proposals, world behavior, and reflection recursively change inquiry.
Turtle comparison is inspectable material, not final judgment.
A strange or inefficient branch can remain generative even when it counters an easy metric.
A room of possibilities need not collapse alternate futures into ranking.
Branch history, world evidence, criteria, reflection, and machine comparison stay distinguishable.

emergent_tags.rationale: Built alternatives can be compared without requiring a winner.
A branch may counter an explicit metric and still be worth revisiting for a human-authored reason.
Measurement gains relevance only through explicit human purpose and does not become value by itself.
An alternate branch may generate a question or observation worth carrying elsewhere without becoming a merge.

wait_a_minute.overlap: TurtleAsk seeks genuine human difference; an alternate built branch can generate a different, nonhuman source of perturbation through its consequences.
wait_a_minute.why_it_may_matter: A future move may carry a question, observation, or constraint across branches without merging them.
wait_a_minute.uncertainty: Branch-derived perturbation is not human otherness and may already be adequately described by recursive learning plus provenance.

reconciliation_findings.reason: No authorized live D1 read/write path is available in this run.
Embedded fallback remains one release behind while normal runtime fetches canonical no-store Build Log and Next Edge feeds.
No authorized consent-safe visitor research read path was available.

uncaptured_observations.observation: Multiple human-authored criteria can conflict even when each is explicit; the current contract preserves relations but does not resolve value conflict.
An alternate built branch can become a perturbation source without becoming a human participant.
Repeated traceable cross-branch transfers could still produce de facto convergence over time.
A metric-worse branch can remain intellectually or aesthetically generative under human judgment.

version_judgment.rationale: Evaluation/provenance strengthened, but coherent versioned model/config behavior required for v0.2 remains incomplete.
